Body.Content:
Azure Batch Rendering will accelerate large scale rendering jobs to deliver results to our customers faster. This will enable artists, engineers, and designers to submit rendering jobs seamlessly via client applications such as Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max, or via our SDK. They' will have full access to VMs that will allow complete customization of their environment as well as troubleshooting any issues. Batch provides a flexible programming model and SDK so they can easily integrate their own pipeline and workflow. Batch Rendering Service also enables users to easily scale to thousands of cores and only pay for what they use.

Learn more about Azure Batch Rendering.
